PASS: A coalesced drag remains rotation instead of an accidental neuron click
PASS: Mouse wheel zooms the projected network
PASS: Click selection resolves the biological record
PASS: Peak selection uses measured absolute activity
PASS: Group filter constrains neuron selection
PASS: Reset restores the initial camera
PASS: Disconnect never presents retained samples as live
PASS: V returns to the original play state and compact projection
PASS: Inspector preserves an already paused session and hidden compact panel
PASS: Escape closes inspection into the pause menu

PASS: Oversized normalized coordinates cannot overflow the projection
